nodes.summary: If the offspring generating functions satisfy `f₂ ≤ f₁` on `[0, 1]`, then the extinction probabilities satisfy `q₂ ≤ q₁`.
nodes.title: Comparison principle for Galton–Watson extinction

nodes.summary: Superspreading raises the extinction probability (Lloyd-Smith et al. 2005): at a fixed mean `R ≥ 0`, the probability `q_k` that the outbreak started by one case goes extinct is nonincreasing in the dispersion `k > 0`.
nodes.title: Superspreading raises the extinction probability

nodes.summary: The extinction probability of the negative-binomial epidemic is the least fixed point of `G_k` in `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Negative-binomial extinction probability is the least fixed point

nodes.summary: The negative-binomial offspring law is a probability measure (`k > 0`, `R ≥ 0`).
nodes.title: Negative-binomial offspring law is a probability measure

nodes.summary: The negative-binomial offspring law as a measure on `ℕ`.
nodes.title: Negative-binomial offspring distribution

nodes.summary: For `R ≥ 0`, `s ∈ [0, 1]` and `0 < k₁ ≤ k₂`, `G_{k₂}(s) ≤ G_{k₁}(s)`; equivalently `k ↦ k log (1 + x / k)` is nondecreasing for `x ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Monotonicity in the dispersion

nodes.summary: `k = 1` is the geometric offspring law: `G_1(s) = 1 / (1 + R (1 - s))`.
nodes.title: Negative-binomial law with dispersion one is geometric

nodes.summary: The negative-binomial generating function `G_k(s) = (1 + (R / k) (1 - s))^{-k}`.
nodes.title: Negative-binomial probability generating function

nodes.summary: The negative-binomial probabilities are nonnegative for `k > 0`, `R ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the negative-binomial probabilities

nodes.summary: The negative-binomial offspring probability with mean `R` and dispersion `k`: `P(Z = n) = C(k + n - 1, n) p^k (1 - p)^n` with `p = k / (k + R)` (Lloyd-Smith et al. 2005). Meaningful for `k > 0`, `R ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Negative-binomial offspring probabilities

nodes.summary: The generating function of the negative-binomial offspring law is `nbPgf` on `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Generating function of the negative-binomial law in closed form
